column1: # The `just test-uds-x86` scenario: the `/dev/uds` server, driven by `/bin/udstest`.
# One step per line, as `tools/smoke/scenario.tsv` documents: the command, a tab, and the
# whole line its output must produce.
# `udstest` reports a distinct failure code per step, so a gate failure points at the call
# that broke (1–4 socketpair, 5–10 bind/listen/connect/accept, 11–16 the round-trips,
# `SO_PEERCRED` again) rather than at "the sockets did not work". The one line below is
# only printed when every step passed.
